eps.d: Del gives Rodney a job with Trotters Independent Traders .
Del sells a faulty car to an Australian man, and then believe that he and Rodney deserve a night out.
Del finds himself as the peacekeeper bewteen two warring Indian businessmen.
Del rekindles his friendship with an old fiancee of his, much to Rodney and Grandad's horror.
Del gets his hands on a double-decker bus and decides to start his own tour company.
Fearing that a war is coming, Rodney and Grandad persuade Del to build a nuclear war shelter.

eps.t: The Long Legs of the Law
eps.d: Rodney brings shame upon the Trotter family name when he begins dating a policewoman.
Del and Rodney try to get rid of Trigger's grandad's ashes.
Del plays a high stakes game of poker with Boycie.
Rodney dates an older woman, even though her abusive ex-husband is about to be released from prison.
The Trotters get a job at painting a Chinese restaurant, which doesn't quite go according to plan...
The Trotters go on a holiday to Spain, but something is not right with Grandad...
The Trotters are hired to clean some priceless chandeliers in a country mansion.
Rodney is appointed chairman of the local Tenants Association, and Del expects him to use his influence to secure a move to a council bungalow.
Rodney leaves Trotters Independent Traders to go into business with Mickey Pearce.
The Trotters head down south to illegally catch some salmon. But they've got more to worry about... there's an escaped axe-murderer on the loose!
Del goes out with an antiques dealer, who secretly wants to pilfer a painting off of him.

eps.t: May the Force Be with You
eps.d: Del's old school enemy, Roy Slater, returns to Peckham.
Rodney goes on the run after being dubbed "The Peckham Pouncer".
Del persuades Denzil to let him decorate his flat, despite his wife Corrine's objections.
Shocking family secrets of the Trotters come to light when Rodney begins dating the daughter of one of Del's ex-fiancees.
At Grandad's funeral, Del and Rodney meet his long-lost brother, their Uncle Albert.
Del sues the Brewery when Uncle Albert falls down The Nag's Head 's cellar.
Rodney joins an aspiring rock band, and Del becomes their manager.
Del and Rodney babysit Boycie and Marlene's new dog, Duke.
With some help from Del, Rodney tries to find a date for an upcoming party in order to win a bet against Mickey Pearce.
The Trotters hunt for a rare butterfly.
The Trotters meet a pregnant German girl and allow her to stay at the flat.
Del witnesses a miracle at his local church, which creates a media frenzy.
The Trotters are held hostage inside the manager's office of a supermarket by "The Shadow".
Del and Rodney battle for the affections of Trigger's niece Lisa.
Rodney receives a grant to make a local film, but Del sees it as another opportunity to make money.

eps.t: Who Wants to Be a Millionaire?
eps.d: Del's old friend Jumbo Mills returns to Peckham and asks him to help run his car business in Australia.
Del adopts a new yuppy image, and Rodney meets Cassandra at an evening class.
Del acquires a batch of inflatable sex dolls.
Del and friends buy a set of 18 carat gold chains from a retired jeweller.
Del enters one of Rodney's paintings he did as a child into a competition. It wins Rodney and Cassandra a holiday to Spain. However, Del's coming too... and not as Rodney's brother.
Del is suffering from stomach cramps, and refuses to see a doctor. But a séance by Elsie Partridge helps change his mind.
With Rodney getting married, and the Driscoll Brothers demanding their money, Del is left with a difficult decision to make.

Del acquires a satellite dish for Boycie, and Rodney goes to pick Cassandra up from Gatwick Airport, only to discover that her flight's been rerouted to Manchester. Could there be a link connecting the two events?
Del gets his hand on national anthem doorbells, Raquel auditions for a role in a Shakespeare play, and Rodney tries to repair his broken relationship with Cassandra.
Del arranges for Raquel and a club singer named Tony Angelino to perform a duet at The Starlight Rooms.
Del, Rodney, Boycie, Denzil, and Trigger attend a school reunion, but things turn ugly when an old schoolmate turns up...

eps.t: He Ain't Heavy, He's My Uncle
eps.d: Crime is affecting the tenants of Nelson Mandela House, and when Uncle Albert becomes one of the victims, Del decides to take the law into his own hands...

eps.t: Three Men, a Woman, and a Baby
eps.d: The birth of Del and Raquel's baby is imminent.
